_comment: Copy to configs/sources.json and edit. Every source needs a concrete license and a rights_basis. Paths are relative to the directory you run from. The pipeline records what you assert here; it cannot verify it.

sources.name: kowiki
sources.notes: ShareAlike: redistributed derived text must keep CC BY-SA. Download kowiki-latest-pages-articles.xml.bz2 from dumps.wikimedia.org and extract with `wikiextractor --json` (files AA/wiki_00 ... are JSON lines).

sources.name: fineweb2-ko
sources.notes: ODC-By covers the compilation; copyright in individual web pages is separate and is subject to CommonCrawl terms of use. Needs `pip install pyarrow`.

sources.name: kr-statutes
sources.notes: One .txt per statute/ruling, official text only (e.g. via the 국가법령정보 공동활용 Open API). Statutes and court rulings are not protected works under Art. 7 of the Korean Copyright Act; publisher commentary can be.
